cave_node_0_player_3.expression: (() => { const efficiency = idleon.callFunction("Spelunk", "SpelunkingEfficiency", 0, 0); const prowess = idleon.callFunction("ArbitraryCode", "SpelunkingProwess"); const difficulty = Number(idleon.getAttr("MonsterDefinitionsGET").h.Spelunking0.h.Defence); const ratio = efficiency / difficulty; const harvestChance = ratio >= 0.25 ?
